messages:
nora_csm: Quick signal: Verdant Health wants to add a clinical insights squad plus an internal search team. They want predictable latency for summarization endpoints and plan nightly embeddings. Onboarding is in progress but renewal in ~7 weeks. Could be an expansion or a churn risk if legal/PII roadblocks slow us. @diego_cs any notes from the kickoff?

diego_cs: They reported current realtime QPS ~60, optimistic peak ~350 across new squads. Nightly embeddings ~3.2M docs (avg 800 tokens). They asked about Dedicated pilot for guaranteed p95. Also asked about HIPAA compliance path.

samir_se: 350 qps realtime is fine but we'll need batching config + kernel tuning. For embeddings 3.2M*800 tokens -> big job. Recommend async batch pipeline, chunking, and KV cache retention. Request sample ingest manifest.

nora_csm: Paste of their manifest from infra: ``
embeddings:
  docs: 3200000
  avg_tokens: 800
  shards: 10
  concurrency: 60
  window: 6h
``

pat_infra: Ops note - hosted embeddings concurrency default is 25, projected need 600 -> quota_exceeded. Can stand up temp dedicated pool for pilot but legal must sign BA/PA. Also need to bump KV cache TTL.

zoe_legal: HIPAA concerns: PHI stored in some docs. Private deployment or VPC eval required. Timeline ~3-4 weeks for legal review. We can allow sanitized subset on hosted after signing DPA/NDA.

finance_bot: billing-check: pilot_free_days=14 allowed with finance approval. Need pilot SOW and billing hold form.

samir_se: Technical suggestion: embeddings vector=1536, chunk size 512 for medical notes, quantize to int8 for batch. Should cut costs 30% and reduce memory pressure. I'll share config diff.

nora_csm: Next steps I recommended: 1) propose 2-week Dedicated pilot with burst capacity 2) secure legal PA or sanitized dataset 3) SE + infra enablement call next Tue 4) customer to send sample traffic + eval prompts. They agreed to the pilot in principle but asked for firm dates.

diego_cs: I'll prepare a pilot SOW + enablement checklist. @pat_infra can you confirm how quickly you can provision a temp pool?

pat_infra: Can provision in 48 hours for a temp pool if legal approves NDA. Will include access creds and sample ingest template.

deploybot: created-temp-dedicated-pool/verdant-pilot by pat_infra at 1728883485 :white_check_mark:

nora_csm: Flagging account health: "expansion-opportunity / renewal-watch". I'll update tracker and ping renewal lead. If legal hold delays pilot we escalate.

samir_se: I'll attach the perf checklist and the suggested config diffs to the enablement invite.
